This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This expression redundantly combines a historical time period with a second “time of” phrase; use the shorter time expression. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别人：人们，This scene refers to the group of people Shennong has just observed, not to “other people” contrasted with someone else. [teacher rule: bieren]
3. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了：一天，神农正在路上走，一看到很多人正在吃一些植物，就发现一些人一吃植物就生病了，Here the narrator means that Shennong saw the people, so the verb needs the resultative complement 到. The pattern 一……就…… also needs 就 to introduce the immediate following event. [rule: resultative_complement] [teacher rule: yi_jiu]

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines a historical period with 的时候; “在古代” is correct.
“别人” is wrong here, but the recently mentioned group should be referred to as “他们,” not repeated as “人们.”
“一看” needs “看到,” and the resulting 一……就…… connection is correctly completed with “就.”
